set.body: Goal: add automatic guide derivation from trained scale descriptors so callers do not have to manually specify routine axes and legends. Acceptance: GuidePolicy or equivalent derives x/y axes and color/fill legends from TrainedScale/ScaleDescriptor; explicit GuideSpec remains available as an override; scale-trained breaks/labels are used; tests cover auto axes, auto discrete legend, and explicit override behavior on JVM and JS.
set.title: Graphics: derive guides from trained scale descriptors
